facts.note: Transcript gives the nine o'clock temple strike, the watch-showing, Félix's watch at twenty minutes to nine, and Aurèle scolding him.
Transcript gives the salon clock on the mantel, read when the temple struck ten, showing five minutes to ten.
Transcript gives piquet in the salon without a break until the doctor went out for cigars, and his departure at twenty-eight minutes past ten by the salon clock.
Transcript gives the doctor asking her to play as he left, her sitting at the piano at once, playing until he returned, and stopping when he came in.
Transcript gives the hall clock striking eleven a moment after the doctor came back.
